output.content: The identity and access management system governs the API gateway through a manual request trigger. When a new model version is pushed to the staging environment, the gateway configuration remains locked until a human operator manually approves the access token renewal. This step happens outside the automated CI/CD pipeline. The approval request sits in a shared ticket queue, and the operator updates the gateway policy directly in the console after verifying the request details. The system logs show the timestamp of the manual approval and the subsequent policy change. No automated rule or scheduled task handles this specific governance link. The process relies entirely on the operator noticing the pending request and acting on it within the current shift.
